title: Defense witness didn’t read full financial forensic report on Sara Duterte | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, House of Representatives, Donald Trump

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

Defense witness Rainer Dela Fuente admits he had not read the prosecution’s financial forensic report or reviewed its supporting documents before testifying in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

items: Why on earth is Sara’s team playing videos of departed people for her defense?

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense counsel plays videos of the late chief justice Renato Corona and the late senator Miriam Defensor Santiago.

items: House leaders deny talks of postponing 2028 polls

blocks.text: House leaders deny claims by Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Paolo Panelo that lawmakers were discussing a possible postponement of the 2028 elections.
